scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a sprint and the prominent horses conserve energy
scenarios.body: Spirit Mixer or Blindeybythelights kick clear from their handy positions when the race develops late. The hold-up horses struggle to get into contention from too far back in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sheradann Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a true staying test and recent winner strikes again
scenarios.body: Sheradann builds on last-time-out success with another patient ride from the rear of the field. The extended trip plays to stamina strengths as classier rivals fail to see out the journey properly.
